fields: h, items [{t, d, icon, link, part}]. part: which part the leader points at: "impeller", "motor" or "tag" (default in that order). Best for exactly three items.
best_for: ExplodedService pins a few service promises to an exploded view of the part that service keeps running: a centrifugal pump drawn apart along its shaft on a light drawing sheet, with a leader from three of its parts to the promises.
